2608.21796.title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
2608.21796.paper_summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, they frequently fail to ensure that the reasoning process remains strictly faithful to the retrieved evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SAFE-G, a Structure-Aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation framework, which enables precise evidence localization and trustworthy reasoning. Specifically, we first employ a coarse-grained hybrid search fusing visual and textual modalities to recall candidate documents, and subsequently implement a structure-aware fine-grained graph retrieval that captures structural dependencies to filter noise and pinpoint precise evidence. Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct. This strict alignment constraint compels the model to anchor its response in the retrieved context, effectively enhancing its capability to locate evidence via multimodal features and perform faithful reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek benchmarks demonstrate that SAFE-G outperforms prior methods by a margin of 8.9% and 3.5%, substantially enhancing the overall reasoning accuracy. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G.
2608.21796.paper_summary_zh: 知識基礎的視覺問題回答（KB-VQA）旨在回答需要對外部知識來源進行推理的查詢，超越視覺內容。<lb/>通常，當前的方法融合多模態特徵以檢索外部信息，隨後利用多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）從檢索到的證據中推導答案。<lb/>然而，這些方法常常難以捕捉複雜上下文中的結構關聯，以有效過濾噪聲。<lb/>此外，它們經常無法確保推理過程嚴格忠實於檢索到的證據。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了SAFE-G，一個結構感知的忠實證據引導生成框架，該框架能夠實現精確的證據定位和可靠的推理。<lb/>具體而言，我們首先採用粗粒度的混合搜索，融合視覺和文本模態以回憶候選文檔，隨後實施結構感知的細粒度圖檢索，捕捉結構依賴以過濾噪聲並精確定位證據。<lb/>此外，我們引入了一種增強學習（RL）策略，配合基於證據的獎勵，僅在所選證據正確時為正確答案分配信用。<lb/>這一嚴格的對齊約束迫使模型將其回應固定在檢索到的上下文中，有效提升其通過多模態特徵定位證據和執行忠實推理的能力。<lb/>在百科全書VQA和InfoSeek基準上的廣泛實驗表明，SAFE-G在先前方法的基礎上提高了8.9%和3.5%的性能，顯著提升了整體推理準確性。<lb/>我們的源代碼已公開，網址為：https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G。
